standard.coverage: Employers with TWO OR MORE employees (21 V.S.A. 384).
standard.note: Annual adjustment: the greater of 5% or the CPI increase, capped at 5%.

tipped.note: Vermont caps the tip credit at 50% of the minimum wage; the tipped rules reach employees of hotels, motels, tourist places and restaurants who receive more than $120 a month in tips.

knownGaps: The 2027 rate was announced and loaded on 2026-11-13: $14.91 standard and $7.46 tipped cash wage (Vermont DOL release). The maximum tip credit is stored as $7.45, the standard rate less the tipped cash wage the department published.
